name: Book appointments into Google Calendar with Telegram alerts and reminders

nodes.name: Sticky Note — what this template does

parameters.content:
## Book appointments into Google Calendar

**Who's it for.** Any business that books people in — dentists, physios, salons, garages, driving instructors. Anyone who loses half an hour a day to "when can you fit me in?"

## How it works

A webhook takes whatever your form or chat tool posts. The message is read for what they want, how urgent it sounds and when they'd like to come — urgency is decided first, so "hurting badly since last night" can never be filed as routine.

Your real Google Calendar is checked and three genuinely free slots are offered; morning people get mornings, emergencies get the soonest hour and also wake the owner on Telegram.

The customer replies 1, 2 or 3. The appointment is created in Google Calendar, the owner gets a Telegram note, and a Wait node holds until the day before the visit — then the reminder goes out by email, or, if no email was left, the owner is told to call.

## Setup steps

1. Add your **Google Calendar** credential to both calendar nodes.
2. Add your **Telegram** credential to the three Telegram nodes.
3. Put your chat id, working hours and appointment length in the two **Your settings** nodes.
4. Point your website form at the two webhook URLs (enquiry and confirmation).
5. Optional: add an SMTP credential so reminders go out by email.

No AI, no per-message cost. The logic is rules you can read and edit.

## 1 · Understand the message

The webhook accepts whatever your form posts. The code reads what they want, how urgent it is, and when they'd like to come. Swap the word lists for the words your customers actually use.

## 2 · Offer three REAL slots

Busy times come from your Google Calendar; the code offers three genuinely free slots that respect the customer's preference. Working hours live in Your settings.

## 3 · Confirm → into the diary

The page posts the chosen slot back. The event is created in Google Calendar with the phone and message in the notes; owner and customer both get a confirmation.

## 4 · The reminder actually goes out

The Wait node sleeps until 24 h before the visit. Email if the customer left one — otherwise the owner gets a Telegram nudge to call. A reminder never disappears silently.

## Telegram

Add your credential to the three Telegram nodes; the chat id comes from Your settings. Only emergencies, bookings and due reminders reach your phone.
